'''Nanta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] shaman in the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who broke a curse that kept an entire village asleep. "Nanta" was a popular name for [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Nanta/Legends|a warrior]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Movie Heroes|pack=Ewok Pack|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Ewok_Pack_2012_Star_Wars_Movie_Heroes_Hasbro.asp}}</ref> who fought and died in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nanta was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
